tasks.label: 🔴 Start Redis Server (Docker)
args: Write-Host '🔴 Redis Server (Docker)' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Checking Docker...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $existing = docker ps -a --filter 'name=lokifi-redis' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null; if ($existing -eq 'lokifi-redis') { $running = docker ps --filter 'name=lokifi-redis' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null; if ($running -eq 'lokifi-redis') { Write-Host '✅ Redis container already running' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '▶️ Starting Redis container...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker start lokifi-redis; Write-Host '✅ Redis started' -ForegroundColor Green } } else { Write-Host '🚀 Creating Redis container...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker run -d --name lokifi-redis -p 6379:6379 -e REDIS_PASSWORD=23233 --restart unless-stopped redis:latest redis-server --requirepass 23233; Write-Host '✅ Redis created and started' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '📋 Connection Details:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '   URL: redis://:23233@localhost:6379/0' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Password: 23233' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Container: lokifi-redis' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 To stop: docker stop lokifi-redis' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '💡 To manage: .\manage-redis.ps1' -ForegroundColor Gray; } else { Write-Host '❌ Docker not found!' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host 'Please install Docker Desktop' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 🔧 Start Backend Server
args: Write-Host '🔧 Backend Server (FastAPI)' -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd apps/backend; if (Test-Path venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1) { ./venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1 } else { python -m venv venv; ./venv/Scripts/Activate.ps1; pip install -r requirements.txt }; Write-Host '📡 Starting on http://localhost:8000' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $env:PYTHONPATH=(Get-Location).Path; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tasks.label: 🎨 Start Frontend Server
args: Write-Host '🎨 Frontend Server (Next.js)' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd apps/frontend; if (-not (Test-Path node_modules)) { Write-Host '📦 Installing dependencies...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npm install }; Write-Host '🌐 Starting on http://localhost:3000' -ForegroundColor Cyan; npm run dev

tasks.label: �️ Start PostgreSQL Server (Docker)
args: Write-Host '🗃️ PostgreSQL Server (Docker)' -ForegroundColor Blue; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Checking Docker...' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $existing = docker ps -a --filter 'name=lokifi-postgres' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null; if ($existing -eq 'lokifi-postgres') { $running = docker ps --filter 'name=lokifi-postgres' --format '{{.Names}}' 2>$null; if ($running -eq 'lokifi-postgres') { Write-Host '✅ PostgreSQL container already running' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '▶️ Starting PostgreSQL container...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker start lokifi-postgres; Write-Host '✅ PostgreSQL started' -ForegroundColor Green } } else { Write-Host '🚀 Creating PostgreSQL container...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker run -d --name lokifi-postgres -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=lokifi -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=lokifi2025 -e POSTGRES_DB=lokifi --restart unless-stopped postgres:16-alpine; Write-Host '✅ PostgreSQL created and started' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '📋 Connection Details:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '   URL: postgresql://lokifi:lokifi2025@localhost:5432/lokifi' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   User: lokifi' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Password: lokifi2025' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Database: lokifi' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   Container: lokifi-postgres' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 To stop: docker stop lokifi-postgres' -ForegroundColor Gray; } else { Write-Host '❌ Docker not found!' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host 'Please install Docker Desktop' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: 📊 Start Coverage Dashboard
args: Write-Host '📊 Coverage Dashboard' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; cd apps/frontend; Write-Host '🔄 Checking coverage data...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (-not (Test-Path coverage-dashboard/data.json)) { Write-Host '⚠️ No coverage data found. Generating initial coverage...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; npm run test:coverage 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ Coverage data generated' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️ Tests had issues but continuing...' -ForegroundColor Yellow } } else { Write-Host '✅ Coverage data found' -ForegroundColor Green }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🌐 Starting dashboard server on http://localhost:3002' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '📁 Serving from: coverage-dashboard/' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 Dashboard Features:' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   ✓ Live coverage metrics' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   ✓ File-level coverage breakdown' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   ✓ Trend analysis and visualizations' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   ✓ Auto-refreshes with test runs' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🔄 To update coverage: npm run test:coverage' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host ''; npx serve coverage-dashboard -l 3002

tasks.label: 🛑 Stop All Servers
args: Write-Host '🛑 Stopping All Servers' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '🔴 Stopping Redis...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker stop lokifi-redis 2>$null; Write-Host '🗃️ Stopping PostgreSQL...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker stop lokifi-postgres 2>$null; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '✅ All Docker containers stopped' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 Terminal servers (Backend, Frontend, Dashboard) should be closed manually' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '   Press Ctrl+C in each terminal or close the terminal windows' -ForegroundColor Gray

tasks.label: 🔄 Restart All Servers
args: Write-Host '🔄 Restarting All Servers' -ForegroundColor Magenta; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '⚠️ MANUAL STEP REQUIRED:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '   1. Close all terminal windows (Backend, Frontend, Dashboard)' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   2. Press Ctrl+C in each terminal OR close the terminal tabs' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '   3. Then run the "🚀 Start All Servers" task again' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '� Stopping Docker containers...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; docker stop lokifi-redis lokifi-postgres 2>$null; Write-Host '✅ Docker containers stopped' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '💡 After closing terminal servers, use:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '   Ctrl+Shift+P → Tasks: Run Task → 🚀 Start All Servers' -ForegroundColor Gray
